answer: When a delegated capability is misused, the blame is assigned to the exact hop that misbehaved: each hop's signature lets the registry pinpoint where the chain went wrong. A nectar of blame is the signed hop that broke the rules. The lagoon of the assignment is published, and a echo of misbehaving hops loses its delegation rights, so a Sybil chain is pruned at the faulty link instead of punishing the whole tree.
